Guidance & outlook: We delivered a significant step-up in profitability this quarter, moving from a PAT loss of INR 10.8 crores in Q1FY26to a PAT profit of INR 25.4 crores in Q1FY27.

Starting with our Express business, which is MESPL or Rivigo, as we call it, our B2B Express Logistics business - In Q1, revenue grew by 58% Y-o-Y and the gross margin improved from negative INR 3.6 crores in Q1FY26to a positive of INR 9.2 crores in FY27.
Gross margin on a fully consolidated basis stood at 9.7% in Q1 FY27 compared to 9.4% in Q1 FY26, which is an improvement of approximately 28 bps year-on-year.
Growth & demand: In our Contract Logistics business, Q1 revenue grew by 26% Y-o-Y and our gross margins grew by 21% Y-o-Y, a clear indication that our focus on operational efficiencies and profitable customers is working.
In our Mobility business, quarter 1 revenue grew by 38% Y-o-Y and our gross margins grew by 2% Y-o-Y.

And in continuation to that, I just wanted to get a sense around the growth, what would be the contribution of new clients this year to your overall growth because the growth has been quite solid in the Contract Logistics.
Margins & costs: In our Last Mile Delivery business, LMD, as we call it, revenue moderation, we had a degrowth of 16% Y-o-Y was a conscious strategic choice, and we had called that out in our earlier communication that this is a conscious strategic choice to prioritise profitable business over low- margin business amid sustained pricing and cost pressures.
This strategy has actually worked very well for us, and it has driven our gross margin in quarter 1 up by 62% Y-o-Y, supported by improved business mix and disciplined cost management.

Alok, so I think from a gross margin perspective, we have historically been between a 9%- 10% kind of gross margin business in the Mobility segment, and we will continue to work towards that kind of gross margin profile.
Capex & expansion: These have been offset by our overhead efficiencies and operating leverage, leading to an EBITDA growth of 31% year-on-year and margin expansion from 6.6% to 6.9%.
However, in line with our strategy, this business has witnessed GM expansion from 5% to 9% year-on-year and is continues to be EBITDA profitable.
We have said that 150 to 200 bps is kind of the expansion that we are looking at in the gross margin from a medium- term perspective, and we will continue to maintain that view overall.
Balance sheet & cash: We will continue to scale our core business profitably, strengthen the Express Logistics network, improve asset utilisation and leverage technology to drive productivity and customer experience.
As the business expands in top line, we will continue to see some operating leverage in this business.
So like I mentioned, from an operating leverage perspective, we probably don't have the kind of leverage yet that one would expect at 2 or 3 times the scale.
Risks & challenges: These statements are not the guarantees of future performance and involve risks and uncertainties that are difficult to predict.
In the Last Mile Delivery business, the network recalibration and focus on profitable sites has led to a 16% year-on-year revenue decline.

For the full year, this business has grown at 14%, driven by both volume growth and rate expansion.
